question: Where can I get cadastral parcel boundaries (geometry) for all of the United States, with parcel identifier and area, as a bulk download or as a queryable service?

answer.summary: No single official federal cadastral parcel dataset or registry covers all of the United States; parcel mapping is maintained locally by 3,000+ counties and towns. Per NSGIC 2025 GMA, 36 states + D.C. run statewide programs, and only 22 (43%) publish 100% open parcels via API or bulk download (e.g., FL, NC, WI, DC); others are partial (NY, TX 403-blocked), county-only (CA), or web-only. For free nationwide bulk GeoParquet (158.1M polygons, parcelid, calcarea), use Hugging Face landrecords/us-parcel-layer (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, non-commercial only). Commercial nationwide bulk/API access is available via Landrecords.us, Regrid, ReportAll, LightBox, and ATTOM.
main_caveats: No federal cadastral registry exists: land records sit across 3,000+ counties/municipalities. Only 22 of 51 state/D.C. jurisdictions have 100% open public parcels via API or bulk download (NSGIC 2025 GMA).
Free nationwide HF GeoParquet (112.8 GB, 158.1M rows) is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (no commercial use or derivative redistribution); HF datasets-server /filter SQL failed in tests (422/502).

HF README vs file mismatch: README says ownername/owneraddr are REDACTED and describes archive.zip (~115 GB, 157M), whereas the repo serves LR_PARCEL_NATIONWIDE_FILE_US_2026_Q3.parquet (158.1M rows, row 0 has populated ownername).

Area semantics and IDs vary locally: WI Menominee shapefile distinguishes GISACRES, ASSDACRES, and DEEDACRES and marks tribal parcels PARCELID='TRIBAL'; official layers report area in projection units (ft2 or m2).
Automated bulk access is blocked on some official portals: Texas TxGIO StratMap ZIP downloads returned HTTP 403 CloudFront errors and its MapServer had Query disabled (400).
answer.confidence_reason: Verified via FGDC/NSGIC 2025 GMA report, sampled official state/county REST APIs and Menominee WI shapefile download, HF schema/WKB/area validation, and 5 commercial vendors.

attributes.note: Full US EPSG:4326 MultiPolygons in HF (CC BY-NC-ND) & commercial layers; free official bulk/API covers only 22/51 state/DC jurisdictions completely.
HF parcelid and commercial layers populate 95-100% per state (syntax varies); official portals use local names (PARCELNO, parno, PARCELID, SSL, APN).
HF/commercial layers include calcarea (m2) & taxacres; official layers mix GISACRES, ASSDACRES, DEEDACRES, sq ft, or native projection Shape_Area.

steps: Inspect file headers or query row groups via HTTP Range requests against https://huggingface.co/datasets/landrecords/us-parcel-layer/resolve/main/LR_PARCEL_NATIONWIDE_FILE_US_2026_Q3.parquet (112,805,340,827 bytes, accept-ranges: bytes) using DuckDB httpfs/spatial or curl -r.

For quick row previews without downloading 112.8 GB, paginate https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows with &offset=N&length=100, or download converted shard URLs listed at /parquet?dataset=landrecords/us-parcel-layer.
Decode base64/hex WKB geom as EPSG:4326 MultiPolygon; note commercial use is forbidden under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
reading_traps: README says archive.zip (~115 GB, ~157M rows) and marks ownername REDACTED, whereas HF actually hosts LR_PARCEL_NATIONWIDE_FILE_US_2026_Q3.parquet (112.8 GB, 158,130,807 rows) and row 0 includes ownername.
HF Datasets Server /filter SQL endpoint failed on string/integer filters (422 / 502) in live tests; use Parquet Range queries (DuckDB/PyArrow) instead of /filter.
calcarea matches EPSG:5070 Albers Equal Area calculation (3227.93 m2), whereas taxacres is assessor-reported acreage and is often null or slightly different.

problems: Datasets Server /filter returned HTTP 422 on statefp='06' and HTTP 502 on taxyear=2025.
Offset 158000000 timed out/empty response while offsets 0 (AL), 40M (NJ), 80M (IL), and 120M (TX) returned valid 200 JSON.

steps: Check NSGIC GMA 2025 report Appendix B to see whether the target state offers a 100% open statewide program (FL, NC, WI, DC, etc.) or requires county-level portals (CA, IL, etc.).

regulator.name: Federal Geographic Data Committee (FGDC) — Cadastral Subcommittee (coordination only; parcel creation and assessment are governed by state and county laws)

operators.note: Over 3,000 U.S. counties/county-equivalents and hundreds of New England municipalities (e.g., 530 jurisdictions in ME, 254 counties in TX) serve as local assessors/recorders; 36 states + D.C. aggregate statewide.

publication_obligation.norm: No federal statute mandates open nationwide publication of county tax parcels. The Geospatial Data Act of 2018 (43 U.S.C. Ch. 46) binds federal agencies for NGDA themes; mandates exist only under scattered state laws such as Wisconsin Act 20 (2013).
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Under 43 U.S.C. Ch. 46 federal agencies publish NGDA themes (federal PLSS grid, not private tax parcels); only certain states (e.g., Wisconsin DOA/WLIP Act 20) mandate statewide county parcel submission.
publication_obligation.frequency: No uniform federal cadence; update frequency depends on state/county statutes and budgets (e.g., annual in WI V12, quarterly/ongoing in FL and NC).

consolidated_republication.note: No official federal consolidated republication of all U.S. cadastral parcels exists; state-level consolidation covers 37 jurisdictions partially or fully, while national consolidation is private/non-official.
